name: voibecode
description: VoibeCode — Air Traffic Control for AI Coding Agents (Multi-workspace radar, away-mode phone alerts, voice triage & daily ship receipts)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/worker && npm run build --workspace=packages/extension && npm run build --workspace=packages/antigravity-plugin && npm run package:antigravity && npm run build --workspace=packages/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/extension && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/antigravity-plugin
scripts.package:all: npm run package:extension && npm run package:antigravity
